summary: Build practical skills in OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, SLOs, and incident diagnosis. Explore the course and plan team training.
lede: Cloud observability helps DevOps, SRE, and cloud operations teams use telemetry to assess service health and investigate failures. Training covers OpenTelemetry coverage, Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards, along with trace analysis, SLI and SLO measurement, alert design, and incident response. Practical exercises develop skills in mapping telemetry, reviewing alerts, and planning reliability improvements.
audienceIntro: This course suits technical professionals responsible for instrumenting, operating, or improving cloud and DevOps services. It is designed for people who need to turn telemetry into service-health decisions and actionable incident response.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with cloud services, application operations, or DevOps workflows is recommended. You should recognize basic networking and service-availability concepts; prior Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry experience is helpful but not required. Coding is not required for course completion.
